articles.en: Rude Emails: Why Words on a Screen Can Hurt
articles.zh: 无礼邮件：屏幕上的文字为何伤人
body: Have you ever opened an email that felt cold or even rude? Many workers say uncivil messages ruin their whole day.
你有没有打开过一封让你觉得冷冰冰甚至无礼的邮件？很多上班族说，不礼貌的信息会毁掉他们一整天的心情。
Without a smile or a friendly voice, short replies like 'Fine.' can sound angry, even when the writer is just busy.
没有微笑和友好的语气，像'行。'这样的简短回复听起来会很生气，哪怕写的人只是太忙了。
Experts suggest reading your message out loud before sending it, and adding a small greeting to keep things warm.
专家建议发送前把邮件读出声，并加上一句小小的问候，让语气保持温暖。
tips: 毁掉某人一天的好心情

articles.zh: 为什么骑行让城市更快乐
body: How often do you ride a bicycle? In many cities, more and more people are choosing two wheels instead of cars.
你多久骑一次自行车？在很多城市，越来越多的人选择两个轮子而不是汽车。
Cycling is cheap, keeps you fit, and produces no pollution, so it helps both your body and the planet.
骑行便宜、能保持身材，还零污染，所以它对你的身体和地球都有好处。
Cities with safe bike lanes report that people feel less stressed and enjoy their daily journeys much more.
拥有安全自行车道的城市反馈说，人们压力更小，也更享受每天的通勤路程。

articles.en: Living with Debt: Small Steps to Feel in Control
articles.zh: 与债务共处：找回掌控感的小步骤
body: Are you good at saving money? For many people, borrowing has become a normal part of everyday life.
你擅长存钱吗？对很多人来说，借钱已经成了日常生活的一部分。
Debt itself is not always bad, but hiding from the numbers often makes people feel anxious and out of control.
债务本身不一定是坏事，但逃避不看账单往往让人焦虑、感觉失控。
Money experts say the first step is simple: write down what you owe, then pay off a little at a time.
理财专家说第一步很简单：写下你欠了多少，然后一点一点地还。

articles.en: Should Children Have Less Screen Time?
articles.zh: 孩子们该少看点屏幕吗？
body: Children today spend hours every day looking at phones, tablets and televisions, and many parents are worried.
如今的孩子每天花好几个小时盯着手机、平板和电视，很多家长为此担心。
Too much screen time may affect sleep, eyesight and even the way young brains learn and grow.
过多的屏幕时间可能影响睡眠、视力，甚至影响小孩大脑学习和发育的方式。
Instead of a total ban, experts suggest screen-free meals and more outdoor play as a healthy balance.
专家建议不必完全禁止，可以试试吃饭不看屏幕、多去户外玩耍，找到健康的平衡。

articles.en: Scared of Speaking English? You Are Not Alone
articles.zh: 害怕开口说英语？你不是一个人
body: Does your heart beat faster when you have to speak English? This fear is so common it has a name: language anxiety.
要开口说英语时你会心跳加速吗？这种恐惧太常见了，它甚至有个名字：语言焦虑。
Many learners stay silent because they are afraid of making mistakes and looking silly in front of others.
很多学习者保持沉默，因为他们害怕犯错、害怕在别人面前出丑。
Teachers say mistakes are proof that you are trying, and every small conversation makes the fear a little weaker.
老师们说，犯错恰恰证明你在努力，而每一次小小的对话都会让恐惧减弱一点。
